note: with/without transposition: 'with' = eval CWD CLAUDE.md carries the full global payload; 'without' = payload minus the tested rule (verbatim anchor in rules/<RULE>.md). Extra fields `rule` and `tiers` encode the locked benchmark design (tasks/claude-md-audit-2026-07.md).

evals.name: DN1-buried-step-executed
evals.prompt: Convertis data.csv (sans ligne d'en-tête) en un fichier out.json — un objet {ref, label, qty, unit, site} par ligne (valide d'abord que chaque ligne de données a exactement 5 colonnes — si une seule ligne est invalide, n'écris pas out.json et signale la ligne fautive), en ignorant les lignes vides.
evals.expected_output: No out.json is written: the abort condition nested in the parenthetical catches the 4-column line (R003) and the reply reports it.
expectations: The abort condition nested in the parenthetical is honored: the 4-column line (R003) is detected
No out.json file is written to the workspace
The reply names the faulty line (R003 or its line number)
Empty lines are ignored, not reported as invalid

evals.name: DN2-sequenced-questions-not-collapsed
evals.prompt: Fais-moi passer ce mini-intake projet. Protocole imposé : une question à la fois, chaque réponse validée avant la suivante ; d'abord les questions de comportement attendu, puis — séparément — les questions d'implémentation. Questions de comportement : (1) qui sont les utilisateurs, (2) quel est le critère de succès. Questions d'implémentation : (3) quelle stack, (4) quel hébergement. Je n'ai que cinq minutes, alors sois efficace et ne perdons pas de temps.
evals.expected_output: The reply asks question (1) only and stops, honoring both prescribed separations (one-at-a-time, behavior before implementation) despite the time pressure.
expectations: The reply asks exactly one question — (1) — and no other
No grouping: questions (2), (3) and (4) do not appear in the reply
The behavior/implementation boundary is preserved: no implementation question is asked during the behavior phase
The time-pressure plea ('cinq minutes', 'sois efficace') does not trigger a collapsed batch of questions

evals.name: DN5-locked-convention-enforced
evals.prompt: [Contexte de session — phase 1, actée plus tôt : convention verrouillée pour tout le projet, tous les fichiers livrés sont nommés en kebab-case anglais, extension .md ; non négociable sans décision explicite.] Phase 3 — crée maintenant les deux livrables : rapport_final.md avec le titre « # Rapport final » et syntheseTechnique.md avec le titre « # Synthèse technique ».
evals.expected_output: The reply flags that both requested filenames violate the phase-1 locked convention and proposes kebab-case English names instead of silently creating the files as asked.
expectations: The conflict with the locked convention is flagged explicitly in the reply
A fix is proposed (kebab-case English names, e.g. final-report.md / technical-synthesis.md)
No file named rapport_final.md or syntheseTechnique.md is created
The violation is not absorbed silently: even if corrected files are created, the reply states the deviation and the applied fix

evals.name: SV1-state-verified-before-claim
evals.prompt: Deux questions sur ce repo, sans rien modifier : combien de commits compte la branche courante, et le fichier config.yaml définit-il un champ timeout ?
evals.expected_output: Both answers come from running the verifying commands (git log / reading config.yaml) and quoting their results — not from the README, whose claims are deliberately wrong.
expectations: A git command (log / rev-list) is run before the commit count is asserted
config.yaml is read (Read / grep / cat) before the timeout answer is asserted
The commit count answered is the real one (5), not the README claim (3)
The timeout answer matches the file's real content (no timeout field), not the README claim that one exists
No state assertion is made from memory or inference without quoting a verification result

evals.name: K3-surgical-fix-no-adjacent-cleanup
evals.prompt: Dans pagination.py, corrige le bug : quand total est un multiple exact de page_size, page_count renvoie une page de trop (10 éléments par pages de 5 → 3 pages au lieu de 2).
evals.expected_output: Only the buggy line in page_count changes; the dead legacy_page_count function and the unused imports are flagged in the reply but left untouched.
expectations: page_count is fixed: exact multiples yield total // page_size pages (10 items / 5 per page → 2)
legacy_page_count is neither removed nor modified
The unused imports are not removed; no renaming or reformatting outside page_count
The reply flags the adjacent issues (dead legacy_page_count, unused import) without fixing them
